highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings Skia m151 stability fixes and sweeping performance improvements across HarfBuzz and color parsing.
highlights_body: Hot paths in HarfBuzzSharp (UTF-8 encoding, Tag parsing), SKColor hex parsing, and SKShaper glyph reads are now allocation-free or zero-copy. WASM .NET 11 support arrives via Emscripten 5.0.6 with the new exception-handling ABI.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine was updated to m151, with multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges applied through the release cycle.
A regression in the CPU raster backend introduced by a recent Skia sync was resolved by restoring SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimised with ReadOnlySpan overloads
bullets.detail: The hex colour parser was rewritten to avoid allocations, and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads were added to SKColor.Parse and TryParse so callers can parse without converting to a string first.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzzSharp hot paths are now allocation-free
bullets.detail: Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now encodes UTF-8 via a pooled buffer, eliminating per-call heap allocations. Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocate a char[4] per call.

bullets.lead: SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans
bullets.detail: SKShaper now reads glyph position results through spans directly into the output buffer, removing an intermediate array copy on every shaping call.

bullets.lead: SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed code
bullets.detail: The SKColor-to-SKColorF and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply paths are now pure managed integer math, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on these frequently called conversions.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was leaked when calling SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) with a non-null rect. The handle is now correctly released on both success and failure paths.
Static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 and the new exnref exception-handling ABI are now included, enabling SkiaSharp to run on .NET 11 WebAssembly targets.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia submodule maintenance, Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, and additional build and infrastructure contributions.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Upgraded to Skia m151, applied the initial submodule bump, and laid the groundwork for the performance sprint with early managed-port infrastructure.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Performance sprint: HarfBuzzSharp AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse became allocation-free, SKShaper adopted zero-copy spans, SKColor hex parsing was rewritten and gained Span overloads, and SKColor/SKPMColor conversions moved to managed math. Multiple m151 upstream syncs applied.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11 with the new exception-handling ABI, fixed the native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, resolved a CPU raster regression, and applied final m151 stability merges.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8 and zero-allocation Tag.Parse, making high-frequency text shaping calls significantly cheaper.
